about_the_game:
After the Catastrophe, humanity harnassed the power of Corite—a mysterious carbon-silicon mineral driving rapid technological recovery. But its pathogenic nature and relentless spread threaten to consume Earth's last habitable spaces. In just decades, Corite is projected to engulf the globe. Humanity must find a way to preserve civilization before the countdown reaches zero.

Resist. Adapt. Escape. Or follow Corite's call and forge a new path.

Uncover the secrets of Corite and fight for the future! Join S.H.A.D.O.W., pilot third-generation BREAK Strikers, and deploy now!

Choose your mecha—assault, melee, sniper, reconnaissance, or support. Battle at breakneck speed across three action-packed modes: Ace Arena (3v3), Operation VERGE (6v6), and Operation STORM (PvPvE). Dodge beams, weave through explosions, and dominate the battlefield!

3v3 or 6v6

Dive into the action with 3v3 Deathmatch, where no price is too great for victory, or dominate the 6v6 Hero Shooter, where sharp skills and smart teamwork turn the tide!

Gear up for heart-pounding battles, lightning-fast moves, and explosive firepower. Get up close and personal with an imposing battle-axe, unyielding halberd, or agile laser sword in intense brawls. Master precise blocks and unleash lethal parries. Prefer ranged combat? Snipe from the shadows, blast through defenses with energy beams, or rain down destruction with a missile barrage.

PvPvE Extraction

Go solo or squad up with three mechs to infiltrate the massive Corite-rich Mashmak Islands. Pilot your third-generation BREAK Strikers and charge into action—seize supplies, take down colossal threats, secure Restricted Zones, and annihilate enemy forces. With Pulse Storms spreading fast, it's a race against time. Complete your objectives, upgrade your arsenal with special materials, and return safely!

Customization

Make your mark on the battlefield with fully customized mechs and pilots! Choose from endless colors, insignias, patterns and accents to craft your unique mecha masterpiece. These aren't just war machines—they're the embodiment of your will!

Characters

Explore your S.H.A.D.O.W. hangar and discover its secrets. Unlock a lineup of legendary pilots with rich backstories, and join forces to secure humanity's survival. Along the way, recruit new allies—each with unique stories and motivations—ready to fight by your side and forge a new future!

content_descriptors.notes: Some game content contains revealing clothing and general mature content and may not be suitable for all ages.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500/AMD Ryzen 3 1300X or above
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650/AMD Radeon RX 570 or above
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: For the best experience, install the game on an SSD.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K/AMD Ryzen 7 5700X3D or above
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060/AMD Radeon RX 5700XT/Intel Arc B580 or above
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: For the best experience, install the game on an SSD.

short_description: Squad up in Mecha BREAK, a multiplayer third-person shooter offering players three game modes filled with high-octane ground and aerial combat. Pilot your Striker into the breach and take on enemies across worldwide hotspots. Ready for the ultimate showdown?
supported_languages:
English*, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese*, Korean, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Russian, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Spain, Thai
*languages with full audio support
